summary: This bill amends the Homeland Security Act to require FEMA to conduct ongoing stakeholder outreach, annual surveys, and feedback incorporation for Urban Area Security Initiative and State Homeland Security Grant Program awards, and to submit related reports to Congress after two and three years.

scores.thoughts: This bill requires FEMA to provide outreach and support for existing preparedness grants and conduct surveys. While these activities might incur some administrative costs, the bill does not directly authorize new spending programs or significantly alter the funding levels of the grants themselves. The focus is on improving the administration and stakeholder engagement for existing grant programs.
